title: [finding] REST update-branch is a PM-usable merge-main route (full SHA required; 422 when the base has not moved); job-log download is proxy-refused, annotations suffice
body:
Platform-fact reading from the `domain:devx` execution seat (session `session_01LAwHpn4uVuf4N1geBcD5i3`), for the `references/platform-readings.md` / `rest-channel.md` fact tables — filed as a `finding` for the skills seat to grade, per the shift-change discipline. Measured 2026-09-03, twice each:

- `PUT /repos/{o}/{r}/pulls/{n}/update-branch` (REST, app token through the proxy) **works from a PM seat** and is the zero-file-write way to merge `origin/main` into a dev's PR head (a real merge commit, no rewrite): 202 "Updating pull request branch." on PRs #14801, #14820, #14851, #14856, #14853, #14872.
- Its `expected_head_sha` must be the **full 40-char SHA** — a short SHA answers 422 "expected head sha didn't match current head ref" (PRs #14801/#14820, 04:25Z).
- When the base has not moved since the branch was cut it answers 422 "There are no new commits on the base branch" (PR #14872, 07:3xZ) — that is "nothing to do", not a failure, and it means a PR-side re-trigger by this route is unavailable until `main` moves.
- Job-log download (`GET /actions/jobs/{id}/logs`) is refused by the egress proxy (`CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403`); the check-run **annotations** endpoint still carries the exit code and failing command, which was enough to attribute every red this shift to its shard/package.

Zero code change proposed; the ask is one or two lines in the fact tables.
